title: Idly
summary: I'DLY, adverb In an idle manner; without employment. 1. Lazily; sluggishly. 2. Foolishly; uselessly; in a trifling way. A shilling spent idly by a fool, may be saved by a wiser person. 3. Carelessly;

inlines.v: I'DLY, adverb In an idle manner; without employment. 1. Lazily; sluggishly. 2. Foolishly; uselessly; in a trifling way. A shilling spent idly by a fool, may be saved by a wiser person. 3. Carelessly; without attention. 4. Vainly; ineffectually; as, to reason idly against truth.
